The 33-year-old Bayern Munich striker is the fifth Englishman to win in total, with Stanley Matthews (1956), Bobby Charlton (1966) and Kevin Keegan (1978 and 1979) the others. Denis Law of Scotland (1964) and Northern Ireland's George Best (1968) are the other winners from the United Kingdom. Real Madrid and France forward Kylian Mbappe finished second, while Barcelona and Spain attacker Lamine Yamal completed the top three. events.title: 達卡拉力賽官方宣布2027年賽事將不再於沙烏地阿拉伯舉行
events.why_matters: 全球頂級越野賽事主辦地點重大變更。
events.summary: 根據路透社報導標題，達卡拉力賽主辦單位宣布，2027年賽事將不再於沙烏地阿拉伯境內舉辦。所附資料僅包含路透社發布的標題訊息，尚未揭露賽事更換主辦地的背後原因、替代舉辦國家或後續賽程路線規劃等具體細節。
events.note: 僅有路透社單一標題，缺乏內文細節。
key_numbers: 2027年｜達卡拉力賽將不再於沙烏地阿拉伯舉行
events.context: 【Reuters】Dakar Rally 2027 will not be held in Saudi Arabia, organisers say Reuters
events.verdict: 僅依可信媒體標題（細節請見原文）
